Show another paywall at a location to the end users a rule matches: add a rule with --when
conditions, or remove one. Rules are read in order after pins, and the first that matches decides;
'voidhash location view' lists them.

Usage:
  voidhash location rule <command> [flags]

Commands:
  add        Show another paywall at a location to everyone its --when conditions hold for.
  remove     Remove one of a location's rules by its number.

Flags:
  -h, --help  Show help for this command

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Run 'voidhash location rule <command> --help' for more about a command.
